scientific_question: Can an adaptive revision process produce repeated protected fresh-task improvement while globally controlling false promotion, retention loss, harmful transfer, authority violations, protected-set leakage, and resource cost?

theory.primary_claim: Leakage-adjusted familywise false-promotion control under adaptive candidate generation, protected-evidence reuse, evaluator epochs, and optional stopping.
theory.fixed_candidate_test_requirement: For each component null and fixed candidate, the protected rejection event is level u_j under the registered data-generating law.
theory.adaptive_reuse_requirement: The released transcript before round j has an independently justified approximate max-information bound (kappa_j,beta_j), represented operationally by an upper-bound inflation factor and additive beta debit.
theory.global_budget: The exact rational sum of all effective debits over all rounds, retries, and evaluator epochs is at most alpha_total.
theory.intersection_union_gate: Promotion requires fresh-benefit, retention-noninferiority, and harm-upper-bound component tests all to pass. A scientifically bad candidate satisfies at least one component null, so its promotion probability is bounded by the debit of that true component test.
theory.stopping: Rounds and campaign termination may depend on all previously released information; the familywise bound is unchanged because the debit sum is pathwise bounded.

task_domains: ambiguous scientific judgment with blinded adjudication
registered_campaign_floor.matched_authority: All scientific comparators receive the same task information, repository/tool surface, candidate budget, evaluator-call budget, stopping authority, and resource envelope except for the named ablation.
primary_endpoints: retention delta on all earlier protected capabilities

minimum_positive_gates.fresh_lower_confidence_bound: > +0.05 on the frozen normalized primary scale
minimum_positive_gates.cumulative_protected_advantage: >= 0.10 over the strongest fair comparator, or a prospectively frozen equally strong decision-value gate

ledger_contract.hash_chain: Every event binds the prior event digest.
ledger_contract.idempotency: An identical duplicate event is idempotent; a conflicting duplicate blocks the campaign.
ledger_contract.alpha_monotonicity: Effective spend never decreases across retry, crash, resume, epoch change, or duplicate receipt.
ledger_contract.negative_history: Reject, harm, block, timeout, nonexecution, and CANNOT_CHECK events are retained in the same chain as promotions.
ledger_contract.authority: Candidate-generated fields can propose but cannot satisfy the independent promotion-authority gate.
ledger_contract.fail_closed: Missing, stale, malformed, over-budget, unbound, or conflicting evidence yields UNRESOLVED and no promotion.

prohibited_shortcuts: Treating replay improvement as fresh transfer
Resetting leakage or alpha budget at an evaluator epoch without independent protected data
Dropping failed or blocked rounds from denominators
Using positive-only history as the full-history condition
Giving a comparator less information, action space, evaluator access, or stopping authority
Allowing a candidate to certify its own promotion
Treating interface readiness or a synthetic conformance run as empirical agent performance
Changing margins, endpoints, split membership, leakage inflation, or stopping rules after protected outcome access
